basic_profile.bio: A gaming enthusiast hailing from Calgary, Alberta, I've been diving into the pixelated worlds since my childhood. I'm a huge fan of classic video games, particularly from the 8-bit and 16-bit eras, which is why I frequent subreddits like GiftofGames. When I'm not gaming, you'll find me catching up on the latest space news or cheering for the Calgary Flames. My work as an IT technician keeps me grounded in technology, but gaming is where my heart truly lies. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a foundation in computer science from a local university, I've spent years troubleshooting tech issues and staying up-to-date with the latest in gaming and space exploration. My passion for gaming is self-taught, fueled by countless hours of playing and discussing games with online communities.
